leadText: Magical Pokémon Journey: Eevee the Genius is the sixth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the ninth and 10th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
plainText:
Magical Pokémon Journey: Eevee the Genius is the sixth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the ninth and 10th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
 
==Blurb==
THOSE NUTTY POKéMON

Looks like Almond's a pretty popular Pokémon trainer, because now Hazel's got a rival for Almond's affections...Coconut, Grandpa's other granddaughter, and a self-proclaimed scientific genius! In fact, not only is she smart, but so is her pet Eevee! Can anything that cute really be intelligent? 

Then, on a trip to the fair, Doduo and Dodrio cause trouble.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Eevee... Pokémon Genius!
Panic at the Cherry Blossom Festival

==Important events==
Coconut and Eevee are introduced.
Hazel and Coconut become rivals.
Hazel and her friends attend a cherry blossom festival.
